records.text: Ali, a viewer commenter whose legal identity is unverified, wrote that Erika Kirk went on a media tour with Fox, Bari Weiss and Glenn Beck to portray Owens as a liar and a crazy person before Owens said a bad word about her.
records.speaker: Ali (episode 387 viewer commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Just bravery inspires other people to be brave. Ali (viewer commenter; surname unverified) writes, Erika (Erika Kirk) gets to go on a media tour with Fox, Bari Weiss and Glenn Beck to paint you as a liar and a crazy person before you even said a bad word about her, but you can't share a meme or two. It's not like she was minding her business at home grieving when you went after her. Exactly right. The entire tour was about debunking Candace.
